notes.title: Big Update Patch - v0.1.9
notes.content:
[h3] [b]Hello Employees[/b][/h3]


We're releasing a big update for Prologue. We've made some updates to make it a little closer to early access gameplay

Update notes
[list]
[*]  Now you have a mobile phone. Mobile phone has important messages, bank application for paying debts and games section that you can play in your free time (Games section is not open yet)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506376/473483c100b84143b7ea806d331979d98c0ad623.png[/img]

[*]  Added a bank app so you can track your debts when you set up a company
[*]  Added a few new tasks
[*]  Added some information screens to make the game more understandable
[*]  Updated the game's interface and menus for a cleaner and smoother experience
[*]  The automatic update of the bid list during the day has been removed. Now, if the sector risk status is negative, you can update the bid list and make it better for a certain amount of fee
[*]  Fixed some gameplay and Localization bugs
[*]  Your employees will no longer automatically level up. You will be able to promote your employee with the button that appears when their experience bars are full. In this way, you will be able to see the features that will change when you promote the employee. Even salary increasesːsteamhappyː
[*]  Now the employees you hire have a work speed. As employees get promoted, their speed will increase. In this way, you can get more bids.
[*] A trash can has been added. You can now throw your coffee cups into the trash can. If you make the floor dirty, you may face a fine. You should also get a trash can for your own company
[*]  The mail replying task has been edited. It has become simpler and more fun now
[*]  Balanced Game
[/list]

Don't forget to keep track of your debts and heed the warnings while running your own company.

Your feedback is very valuable to us. For a more flawless office, you can give feedback via the discord channel or the steam community.

Please do not forget to leave a review on the steam page and add the main game to your wishlistːsteamthisː


See you soon with early access

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3537990/Office_Simulator_Prologue/
